title: Measurability and power bound for the floor-counting remainder
statement: Let a : ℕ → ℝ and κ, α, C : ℝ satisfy 0 ≤ α and 0 ≤ C. Suppose that for every integer n ≥ 1, |Σ_{k=1}^n a(k) − κn| ≤ C n^α. Define R(t) = Σ_{k=1}^{Nat.floor(t)} a(k) − κt for every real t, where Nat.floor is the natural-number floor, equal to zero on negative inputs. Then R is measurable for the Borel structures on ℝ, and for every t ≥ 1, |R(t)| ≤ (C + |κ|)t^α. No sign condition on a and no upper bound on α are needed.
lean_statement: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (κ α C : ℝ), 0 ≤ α → 0 ≤ C → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → |(∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, a k) - κ * (n : ℝ)| ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ α) → Measurable (fun t : ℝ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.floor t), a k) - κ * t) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → |(∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.floor t), a k) - κ * t| ≤ (C + |κ|) * t ^ α
